author: KEXP
description: Chelsea Wolfe navigates through darkness with gothic rock, doom metal, and electronic textures. Anchored by her haunting vocals, she shares a performance of "Death Is Not the End" and more Live on KEXP.
title: Chelsea Wolfe performs "Death Is Not the End" & more Live on KEXP
